title: IReactorClient mutations throw a bare Error carrying only job.error?.message, losing the typed class and stack
description: Class, stack and errorHistory are dropped at the client boundary. Drop to IReactor.getJobStatus(jobId) to read JobInfo.error, errorHistory and job.
